testimonials.name: Maya R.
testimonials.text: I've bought three budgeting apps and canceled all three. This is the first one that just lives in a spreadsheet I already know how to use.

testimonials.name: Devon T.
testimonials.text: The red-and-green thing sounds simple but it's honestly the reason I keep opening it every week instead of avoiding it.

testimonials.name: Priya K.
testimonials.text: My favorite part is the dashboard flagging my subscriptions creeping up before my bank statement ever does.
